owner_directive: Fix the bug class where a partial identity is used as a lookup key when a composite identity is required: node_id/block_id keyed without workflow_id, so same-named nodes in different workflows overwrite and impersonate each other. Owner broadened scope to sweep for every reachable instance of the class (run-scoped without run_id, project-scoped without project identity, cache keys missing a dimension, scans that fall back on a partial match without break). Carry the full identity; do not fix by renaming or by adding a break. Every fix needs a test that fails before and passes after. Defer anything that does not fit one reviewable PR with a tracked TODO citing an issue.
